details.challenge: The client needed a platform that could handle high traffic while maintaining a buttery-smooth 60fps interaction experience. The cart state needed to be consistent across multiple tabs and devices.
details.solution: We implemented an advanced asset-loading strategy using Next.js 13 streaming and Suspense. We also utilized a robust global state management setup integrated with local storage for cross-tab synchronization.

features.title: Dynamic Filtering
features.description: Fast and responsive product filtering without page reloads.

features.title: One-Click Checkout
features.description: Streamlined checkout process integrated seamlessly with Stripe.

features.title: Adaptive Layout
features.description: Fully responsive design that adapts to mobile, tablet, and desktop views.

details.challenge: Needed a secure, real-time dashboard for high-net-worth clients.
